## Email Template Manager

Send personalized emails using templates stored in Google Sheets.

**Flow:**
1. Webhook receives template_id, email, name, and variables
2. Read matching template from Sheets library
3. Code fills {{variable}} placeholders
4. Gmail sends personalized email

**Template Sheets columns:** template_id, template_name, subject, body

**Webhook payload:**
```json
{
  "template_id": "welcome-01",
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "name": "John",
  "variables": {
    "company": "Acme",
    "plan": "Premium"
  }
}
```
